name: Self-Intersection Removal via Mesh Deformation
aliases: Self-Intersection Resolving via Winding Number Energy
definition: Deforming a mesh to reduce voxel regions with winding number above one to remove self-intersections.
summary: Self-Intersection Removal via Mesh Deformation resolves overlaps by optimizing a voxelized winding number field, differing from geometric methods by handling complex intersections via volumetric gradients.
